description: This is the main entry point for a Flutter application. It sets up a basic MaterialApp with a home page displaying a centered message indicating that the grocery_frontend App is being generated.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application, sets up the MaterialApp with theme and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the home page, takes a title as parameter.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class for MyHomePage, builds the main UI with app bar and centered message.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, runs the MyApp widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp, MyHomePage, and _MyHomePageState.
